@dataclass

    def to_context_string(self) -> str:

@dataclass
class KnowledgeItem:
    """
    知识项（统一表示）
    
    统一表示来自不同来源的知识，包括：
    - RAGFlow chunk
    - Neo4j 向量搜索节点

        text: 知识内容

        metadata: 附加元数据
    """
    
    id: str
    name: str
    text: str
    source_type: KnowledgeSourceType
    similarity_score: float = 0.0
    element_id: Optional[str] = None
    doc_id: Optional[str] = None
    priority: int = 99
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        """初始化后设置优先级"""
        if self.priority == 99:  # 未设置时根据来源类型设置
            priority_map = {
                KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_VECTOR: 1,
                KnowledgeSourceType.RAGFLOW: 2,
                KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_ADJACENT: 3,
                KnowledgeSourceType.CHAT_HISTORY: 4,
            }
            self.priority = priority_map.get(self.source_type, 99)
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """转换为字典"""
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "name": self.name,
            "text": self.text,
            "source_type": self.source_type.value,
            "similarity_score": self.similarity_score,
            "element_id": self.element_id,
            "doc_id": self.doc_id,
            "priority": self.priority,
            "metadata": self.metadata,
        }
    
    def to_context_string(self) -> str:
        """转换为上下文字符串（用于 LLM）"""
        return f"[{self.id}] {self.name}：{self.text}"

            "source_type": self.source_type,
            "doc_id": self.doc_id,
            "nodeid": self.node_id,
            "metadata": self.metadata

        """转换为 JSON 字符串"""
        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False)


@dataclass
class ReferenceMapping:
    """
    引用映射
    
    管理所有知识项的引用映射关系
    
    Attributes:
        nodes: 引用节点列表
        id_to_node: ID 到节点的映射
    """
    
    nodes: List[ReferenceNode] = field(default_factory=list)
    id_to_node: Dict[str, ReferenceNode] = field(default_factory=dict)
    
    def add_knowledge_item(self, item: KnowledgeItem) -> str:
        """
        添加知识项并返回引用 ID
        
        Args:
            item: 知识项
            
        Returns:
            引用 ID（如 node1）
        """
        node_id = f"node{len(self.nodes) + 1}"
        ref_node = ReferenceNode(
            node_id=node_id,
            element_id=item.element_id or item.id,
            doc_id=item.doc_id,
            name=item.name,
            text=item.text,
            source_type=item.source_type.value,
            metadata=item.metadata,
        )
        self.nodes.append(ref_node)
        self.id_to_node[node_id] = ref_node
        return node_id
    
    def get_all_nodes(self) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
        """获取所有节点的字典表示"""
        return [node.to_dict() for node in self.nodes]
    
    def to_json_map(self) -> str:
        """转换为 JSON 映射字符串"""
        return json.dumps(
            {node.node_id: node.to_dict() for node in self.nodes},
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2
        )


@dataclass
class SSEEvent:
    """
    SSE 事件
    
    用于构建 Server-Sent Events 响应
    
    Attributes:
        event_type: 事件类型
        data: 事件数据
    """
    
    event_type: SSEEventType
    data: str
    
    def to_sse_string(self) -> str:
        """
        转换为 SSE 格式字符串
        
        返回格式：
        - 普通数据: data: xxx
        - 知识点: data: [knowledge_point] {...}
        - 结束: data: [DONE]
        """
        if self.event_type == SSEEventType.DONE:
            return "data: [DONE]\n\n"
        elif self.event_type == SSEEventType.KNOWLEDGE_POINT:
            return f"data: {self.data}\n\n"
        elif self.event_type == SSEEventType.REFERENCE:
            return f"data: {self.data}\n\n"
        elif self.event_type == SSEEventType.QUESTION:
            return f"data: {self.data}\n\n"
        elif self.event_type == SSEEventType.DOC:
            return f"data: {self.data}\n\n"
        elif self.event_type == SSEEventType.VIDEO:
            return f"data: {self.data}\n\n"
        elif self.event_type == SSEEventType.ERROR:
            return f"data: [ERROR] {self.data}\n\n"
        else:
            return f"data: {self.data}\n\n"
    
    @classmethod
    def create_data(cls, data: str) -> "SSEEvent":
        """创建数据事件"""
        return cls(event_type=SSEEventType.DATA, data=data)
    
    @classmethod
    def create_knowledge_point(cls, ref_nodes) -> "SSEEvent":
        """创建知识点事件"""
        return cls(event_type=SSEEventType.KNOWLEDGE_POINT, data=ref_nodes)
    
    @classmethod
    def create_reference(cls, ref_map) -> "SSEEvent":
        """创建引用映射事件"""
        return cls(event_type=SSEEventType.REFERENCE, data=ref_map)

    @classmethod
    def create_question(cls, data) -> "SSEEvent":
        """创建问题事件"""
        return cls(event_type=SSEEventType.QUESTION, data=data)

    @classmethod
    def create_doc(cls, data) -> "SSEEvent":
        """创建文档事件"""
        return cls(event_type=SSEEventType.DOC, data=data)

    @classmethod
    def create_video(cls, data) -> "SSEEvent":
        """创建视频事件"""
        return cls(event_type=SSEEventType.VIDEO, data=data)

    @classmethod
    def create_done(cls) -> "SSEEvent":
        """创建结束事件"""
        return cls(event_type=SSEEventType.DONE, data="")
    
    @classmethod
    def create_error(cls, message: str) -> "SSEEvent":
        """创建错误事件"""
        return cls(event_type=SSEEventType.ERROR, data=message)

    """
    Neo4j 节点

        node_id: 节点 ID
        text: 节点文本内容

            source_type=source_type,
            similarity_score=similarity_score,

    """
    基于历史对话重写查询，生成语义完整、无歧义的独立查询。

        ... )

def _is_self_contained_query(query: str) -> bool:
    """
    判断查询是否是独立可理解的（不依赖上下文）。
    
    Args:
        query: 用户查询
        
    Returns:
        True 如果查询是独立的，False 如果依赖上下文
    """
    # 常见的依赖上下文的代词和指示词
    context_dependent_patterns = [
        r'\b(它|这|那|这个|那个|这些|那些)\b',
        r'\b(他|她|他们|她们)\b',
        r'\b(上面|下面|前面|后面|刚才)\b',
        r'\b(继续|接着|然后呢|还有呢)\b',
        r'\b(为什么|怎么回事)\s*[？?]?\s*$',  # 单独的"为什么"通常需要上下文
        r'^(是的|对|好的|嗯)',  # 回应性开头
    ]
    
    for pattern in context_dependent_patterns:
        if re.search(pattern, query):
            return False
    
    # 查询太短可能依赖上下文
    if len(query.strip()) < 5:
        return False
    
    return True


def _format_chat_history(
    chat_history: List[Any],
    max_turns: int = 5,
    max_chars: int = 1000,
) -> str:
    """
    格式化历史对话用于 prompt。
    
    Args:
        chat_history: ChatMessage 列表
        max_turns: 最大对话轮数
        max_chars: 最大字符数
        
    Returns:
        格式化后的历史对话文本
    """
    if not chat_history:
        return "无历史对话"
    
    # 取最近的对话
    recent_history = chat_history[-max_turns:]
    
    formatted_parts = []
    total_chars = 0
    
    for msg in recent_history:
        # 截断过长的回答
        answer = msg.answer
        if len(answer) > 200:
            answer = answer[:200] + "..."
        
        part = f"用户：{msg.query}\n助手：{answer}"
        
        if total_chars + len(part) > max_chars:
            break
        
        formatted_parts.append(part)
        total_chars += len(part)
    
    return "\n\n".join(formatted_parts) if formatted_parts else "无历史对话"


def _clean_rewritten_query(response: str, original_query: str) -> str:
    """
    清理 LLM 返回的重写查询。
    
    Args:
        response: LLM 响应
        original_query: 原始查询（作为 fallback）
        
    Returns:
        清理后的查询
    """
    if not response:
        return original_query
    
    # 移除常见的前缀
    prefixes_to_remove = [
        "重写后的查询：",
        "重写后：",
        "查询：",
        "重写：",
    ]
    
    cleaned = response.strip()
    for prefix in prefixes_to_remove:
        if cleaned.startswith(prefix):
            cleaned = cleaned[len(prefix):].strip()
    
    # 移除引号
    if cleaned.startswith('"') and cleaned.endswith('"'):
        cleaned = cleaned[1:-1]
    if cleaned.startswith("'") and cleaned.endswith("'"):
        cleaned = cleaned[1:-1]
    
    # 如果结果为空或太短，返回原查询
    if not cleaned or len(cleaned) < 2:
        return original_query
    
    return cleaned


def _build_chunks_text(
    results: "SearchResults",
    max_chunks: int = 20,
    max_chunk_length: int = 500,
    max_total_length: int = 8000,
) -> Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, str]]:
    """
    构建用于 LLM 评估的 chunks 文本。
    
    Args:
        results: SearchResults 对象
        max_chunks: 最大 chunk 数量
        max_chunk_length: 单个 chunk 最大长度
        max_total_length: 总文本最大长度
        
    Returns:
        Tuple of (chunks_text, id_to_item mapping, id_to_source mapping)
    """
    chunks_parts = []
    id_to_item: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    id_to_source: Dict[str, str] = {}  # chunk_id -> source_type
    total_length = 0
    chunk_count = 0
    
    # 按优先级处理各来源：neo4j_vector > ragflow > neo4j_adjacent > history
    source_items = [
        ("neo4j_vector", results.neo4j_vector_items),
        ("ragflow", results.ragflow_items),
        ("neo4j_adjacent", results.neo4j_adjacent_items),
        ("history", results.history_items),
    ]
    
    for source_type, items in source_items:
        for item in items:
            if chunk_count >= max_chunks:
                break
            
            # 获取 item 的 id 和 text
            item_id = item.id
            item_text = item.text or ""
            item_name = getattr(item, 'name', '')
            
            # 截断过长的文本
            if len(item_text) > max_chunk_length:
                item_text = item_text[:max_chunk_length] + "..."
            
            # 构建 chunk 文本
            chunk_text = f"[{item_id}] {item_name}：{item_text}"
            
            # 检查总长度
            if total_length + len(chunk_text) > max_total_length:
                break
            
            chunks_parts.append(chunk_text)
            id_to_item[item_id] = item
            id_to_source[item_id] = source_type
            total_length += len(chunk_text)
            chunk_count += 1
        
        if chunk_count >= max_chunks or total_length >= max_total_length:
            break
    
    return "\n\n".join(chunks_parts), id_to_item, id_to_source


def _parse_relevance_response(
    response: str,
    threshold: float = 0.5,
) -> Dict[str, float]:
    """
    解析 LLM 返回的相关性评估结果。
    
    Args:
        response: LLM 响应（JSON 格式）
        threshold: 相关性阈值
        
    Returns:
        Dict mapping chunk_id to relevance score
    """
    if not response:
        return {}
    
    # 清理响应
    cleaned = response.strip()
    
    # 移除可能的 markdown 代码块标记
    if cleaned.startswith("```json"):
        cleaned = cleaned[7:]
    if cleaned.startswith("```"):
        cleaned = cleaned[3:]
    if cleaned.endswith("```"):
        cleaned = cleaned[:-3]
    cleaned = cleaned.strip()
    
    try:
        data = json.loads(cleaned)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        logger.warning(f"Failed to parse JSON response: {e}")
        # 尝试提取 JSON 对象
        match = re.search(r'\{[\s\S]*\}', response)
        if match:
            try:
                data = json.loads(match.group())
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                logger.error("Failed to extract JSON from response")
                return {}
        else:
            return {}
    
    relevant_ids: Dict[str, float] = {}
    
    # 解析 relevant_chunks
    relevant_chunks = data.get("relevant_chunks", [])
    for chunk in relevant_chunks:
        chunk_id = chunk.get("chunk_id", "")
        score = chunk.get("score", 0.0)
        
        # 确保 score 是数字
        try:
            score = float(score)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            score = 0.0
        
        if score >= threshold and chunk_id:
            relevant_ids[chunk_id] = score
    
    return relevant_ids


def _filter_by_ids(
    results: "SearchResults",
    relevant_ids: Dict[str, float],
    id_to_source: Dict[str, str],
) -> "SearchResults":
    """
    根据相关 ID 筛选结果。
    
    Args:
        results: 原始 SearchResults
        relevant_ids: 相关 chunk ID 到分数的映射
        id_to_source: chunk ID 到来源类型的映射
        
    Returns:
        筛选后的 SearchResults
    """
    from qa_system.models import SearchResults
    
    filtered_ragflow = []
    filtered_neo4j_vector = []
    filtered_neo4j_adjacent = []
    filtered_history = []
    
    # 筛选 ragflow_items
    for item in results.ragflow_items:
        if item.id in relevant_ids:
            # 可选：更新 similarity_score 为 LLM 评估的分数
            # item.similarity_score = relevant_ids[item.id]
            filtered_ragflow.append(item)
    
    # 筛选 neo4j_vector_items
    for item in results.neo4j_vector_items:
        if item.id in relevant_ids:
            filtered_neo4j_vector.append(item)
    
    # 筛选 neo4j_adjacent_items
    for item in results.neo4j_adjacent_items:
        if item.id in relevant_ids:
            filtered_neo4j_adjacent.append(item)
    
    # 筛选 history_items
    for item in results.history_items:
        if item.id in relevant_ids:
            filtered_history.append(item)
    
    return SearchResults(
        ragflow_items=filtered_ragflow,
        neo4j_vector_items=filtered_neo4j_vector,
        neo4j_adjacent_items=filtered_neo4j_adjacent,
        history_items=filtered_history,
    )

def _call_llm_streaming(
    llm_client: Any,
    prompt: str,
    model: Optional[str] = None,

    temperature: float = 0.3,
    system_prompt: str = "",
) -> str:
    """

    Args:
        llm_client: LLM 客户端
        prompt: 用户 prompt
        model: 模型名称
        max_tokens: 最大 token 数
        temperature: 温度参数

        LLM 响应文本
    """
    messages = []
    if system_prompt:
        messages.append({"role": "system", "content": system_prompt})
    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})

        max_tokens=max_tokens,
        temperature=temperature,
        stream=True,
    )
    
    full_response = []
    for chunk in response_stream:
        if chunk.choices and chunk.choices[0].delta.content:
            full_response.append(chunk.choices[0].delta.content)
    
    return "".join(full_response)

"""
问答服务模块

主问答服务，协调所有组件完成问答流程：
1. RAGFlow 混合检索
2. Neo4j 向量搜索 + N-hop 遍历

设计原则：
- 协调者模式：协调各子服务完成任务
- 流式处理：支持 SSE 流式响应
- 容错设计：子服务失败不影响整体流程

Author: AI QA System
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys, re
import traceback
import json
import asyncio
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Generator, List, Optional

from loguru import logger
from openai import OpenAI
from dataclasses import dataclass

from qa_system.config import AppConfig, get_config
from qa_system.context_engineering import ContextEngineer, create_context_engineer
from qa_system.deduplication import Deduplicator, create_deduplicator
from qa_system.embedding_service import EmbeddingService, create_embedding_service
from qa_system.models import (
    ChatMessage,
    KnowledgeItem,
    KnowledgeSourceType,
    QARequest,
    ReferenceMapping,
    SSEEvent,
    SearchResults,
)
from qa_system.qa_prompt import QA_SYSTEM_PROMPT, QUERY_REWRITE_PROMPT, SIMPLE_EXTRACTION_PROMPT
from qa_system.neo4j_client import Neo4jClient, create_neo4j_client
from qa_system.ragflow_client import RAGFlowClient, create_ragflow_client


class QAService:
    """
    问答服务
    
    协调 RAGFlow、Neo4j、Embedding、去重和 LLM 服务完成问答
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        config: AppConfig,
        ragflow_client: Optional[RAGFlowClient] = None,
        neo4j_client: Optional[Neo4jClient] = None,
        embedding_service: Optional[EmbeddingService] = None,
        deduplicator: Optional[Deduplicator] = None,
        context_engineer: Optional[ContextEngineer] = None,
    ):
        """
        初始化问答服务
        
        Args:
            config: 应用配置
            ragflow_client: RAGFlow 客户端（可选）
            neo4j_client: Neo4j 客户端（可选）
            embedding_service: Embedding 服务（可选）
            deduplicator: 去重器（可选）
            context_engineer: 上下文工程师（可选）
        """
        self.config = config
        
        # 初始化子服务
        self.ragflow_client = ragflow_client or create_ragflow_client(config.ragflow)
        self.embedding_service = embedding_service or create_embedding_service(config.qwen)
        self.deduplicator = deduplicator or create_deduplicator(config.deduplication)
        self.context_engineer = context_engineer or create_context_engineer(config.qa)
        
        # Neo4j 客户端延迟初始化（需要连接）
        self._neo4j_client = neo4j_client
        
        # LLM 客户端
        self.llm_client = OpenAI(
            api_key=config.qwen.api_key,
            base_url=config.qwen.base_url,
        )
    
    @property
    def neo4j_client(self) -> Neo4jClient:
        """获取 Neo4j 客户端（延迟初始化）"""
        if self._neo4j_client is None:
            self._neo4j_client = create_neo4j_client(self.config.neo4j)
        return self._neo4j_client
    
    def close(self) -> None:
        """关闭所有连接"""
        if self._neo4j_client:
            self._neo4j_client.close()
            self._neo4j_client = None
    
    async def _search_ragflow_async(
        self,
        query: str,
        dataset_ids: List[str],
        use_threshold: bool = False,
    ) -> List[KnowledgeItem]:
        """
        异步执行 RAGFlow 检索
        
        通过 asyncio.to_thread 将同步 IO 操作转为异步，
        避免阻塞事件循环。
        
        Args:
            query: 查询问题
            dataset_ids: 知识库 ID 列表
            use_threshold: 是否使用相似度阈值模式
            
        Returns:
            KnowledgeItem 列表，失败时返回空列表
        """
        try:
            if use_threshold:
                logger.info("RAGFlow 检索: 使用相似度阈值模式")
                # 将同步调用放入线程池执行
                chunks = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self.ragflow_client.retrieve_threshold,
                    question=query,
                    similarity_threshold=self.config.qa.ragflow_similarity_threshold,
                    dataset_ids=dataset_ids,
                    use_reranker=True,
                )
                logger.info(f"RAGFlow 检索到 {len(chunks)} 个片段（阈值模式）")
            else:
                logger.info("RAGFlow 检索: 使用 Top K 模式")
                chunks = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self.ragflow_client.retrieve_top_k,
                    question=query,
                    top_k=self.config.qa.ragflow_top_n,
                    dataset_ids=dataset_ids,
                    use_reranker=True,
                )
                logger.info(f"RAGFlow 检索到 {len(chunks)} 个片段（Top K 模式）")
            
            # 转换为 KnowledgeItem（CPU 操作，无需 to_thread）
            items = [chunk.to_knowledge_item() for chunk in chunks]
            
            return items
            
        except Exception:
            exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback = sys.exc_info()
            error_message = repr(traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback))
            logger.error(f"RAGFlow 检索失败: {error_message}")
            return []


    async def _search_neo4j_async(
        self,
        query: str,
        use_threshold: bool = False,
        root_element_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> tuple[List[KnowledgeItem], List[KnowledgeItem]]:
        """
        异步执行 Neo4j 向量搜索和 N-hop 遍历
        
        包含三个 IO 操作：
        1. Embedding 生成
        2. 向量搜索
        3. N-hop 邻接节点遍历（多次调用）
        
        Args:
            query: 查询问题
            use_threshold: 是否使用相似度阈值模式
            
        Returns:
            (向量搜索结果, 邻接节点结果) 元组，失败时返回空元组
        """
        if not query or not root_element_id:
            return [], []
        try:
            # Step 1: 生成查询 embedding
            query_embedding = await asyncio.to_thread(
                self.embedding_service.embed_query,
                query,
            )
            
            if not query_embedding or all(v == 0 for v in query_embedding):
                logger.warning("Embedding 生成失败，跳过 Neo4j 搜索")
                return [], []
            
            # Step 2: 向量搜索
            if not use_threshold:
                results = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self.neo4j_client.vector_search_top_k,
                    embedding=query_embedding,
                    top_k=self.config.qa.neo4j_top_k,
                    root_element_id=root_element_id,
                )
            else:
                results = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self.neo4j_client.vector_search_threshold,
                    embedding=query_embedding,
                    similarity_threshold=self.config.qa.neo4j_similarity_threshold,
                    root_element_id=root_element_id,
                )
            
            # 合并向量搜索结果（CPU 操作）
            seen_ids: set[str] = set()
            vector_items: List[KnowledgeItem] = []
            for node, score in results:
                if node.node_id not in seen_ids:
                    seen_ids.add(node.node_id)
                    vector_items.append(
                        node.to_knowledge_item(
                            source_type=KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_VECTOR,
                            similarity_score=score,
                        )
                    )
            
            # Step 3: N-hop 遍历 - 并行获取所有邻接节点
            async def fetch_adjacent(item: KnowledgeItem) -> List[KnowledgeItem]:
                """获取单个节点的邻接节点"""
                if not item.element_id:
                    return []
                
                adjacent_nodes = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self.neo4j_client.get_adjacent_nodes,
                    node_id=item.element_id,
                    max_depth=self.config.qa.n_hop,
                )
                return adjacent_nodes
            
            # 并行获取所有 vector_items 的邻接节点
            adjacent_results = await asyncio.gather(
                *[fetch_adjacent(item) for item in vector_items],
                return_exceptions=True,  # 单个失败不影响整体
            )
            
            # 合并邻接节点结果
            adjacent_items: List[KnowledgeItem] = []
            for result in adjacent_results:
                if isinstance(result, Exception):
                    logger.warning(f"获取邻接节点失败: {result}")
                    continue
                
                for adj_node in result:
                    if adj_node.node_id not in seen_ids:
                        seen_ids.add(adj_node.node_id)
                        adjacent_items.append(
                            adj_node.to_knowledge_item(
                                source_type=KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_ADJACENT,
                                similarity_score=0.0,
                            )
                        )
            
            logger.info(f"Neo4j 搜索完成: 向量结果={len(vector_items)}, 邻接结果={len(adjacent_items)}")
            return vector_items, adjacent_items
            
        except Exception:
            exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback = sys.exc_info()
            error_message = repr(traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback))
            logger.error(f"Neo4j 搜索失败: {error_message}")

            results = asyncio.run(self._search_all_sources(request))

            # Step 4: MinHash 去重（按优先级）
            all_items = self.deduplicator.deduplicate_by_source(
                neo4j_vector_items=results.neo4j_vector_items,
                ragflow_items=results.ragflow_items,
                neo4j_adjacent_items=results.neo4j_adjacent_items,
                chat_history_items=results.history_items,
            )
            
            # Step 5: 上下文工程
            context, reference_mapping = self.context_engineer.build_context(

    async def _search_all_sources(

        - 每个任务独立超时，防止慢查询拖垮整体

        """
        
        async def safe_ragflow_search() -> list:
            """RAGFlow 搜索，带独立异常处理"""
            try:
                return await asyncio.wait_for(
                    self._search_ragflow_async(
                        query=request.query,
                        dataset_ids=request.dataset_ids,
                    ),
                    timeout=10.0,  # 独立超时
                )
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                logger.warning("RAGFlow 搜索超时，返回空结果")
                return []
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"RAGFlow 搜索失败: {e}")
                return []
        
        async def safe_neo4j_search() -> tuple[list, list]:
            """Neo4j 搜索，带独立异常处理"""
            try:
                return await asyncio.wait_for(
                    self._search_neo4j_async(query=request.query, root_element_id=request.element_id),
                    timeout=15.0,  # Neo4j 可能需要更长时间
                )
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                logger.warning("Neo4j 搜索超时，返回空结果")
                return [], []
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Neo4j 搜索失败: {e}")
                return [], []
        
        async def safe_convert_history() -> list:
            """历史转换，CPU 操作但为保持一致性也包装"""
            try:
                # CPU 密集型操作，可以考虑 run_in_executor

                return []
        
        # 并行执行，任何一个失败不影响其他
        ragflow_result, neo4j_result, history_result = await asyncio.gather(
            safe_ragflow_search(),
            safe_neo4j_search(),
            safe_convert_history(),
        )
        
        neo4j_vector_items, neo4j_adjacent_items = neo4j_result
        
        return SearchResults(
            ragflow_items=ragflow_result,
            neo4j_vector_items=neo4j_vector_items,
            neo4j_adjacent_items=neo4j_adjacent_items,
            history_items=history_result,
        )

        referenced_node_ids = re.findall(r'\[node\d+\]', full_text)

"""
问答服务模块

主问答服务，协调所有组件完成问答流程：
1. 查询重写（消除代词、补充上下文）
2. RAGFlow 混合检索
3. Neo4j 向量搜索 + N-hop 遍历
4. LLM 结果筛选
5. MinHash 去重
6. 上下文工程
7. LLM 流式生成
8. SSE 响应输出

设计原则：
- 协调者模式：协调各子服务完成任务
- 流式处理：支持 SSE 流式响应
- 容错设计：子服务失败不影响整体流程

Author: AI QA System
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import re
import traceback
import json
import asyncio
from collections import defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, Generator, List, Optional, Tuple

from loguru import logger
from openai import OpenAI

from qa_system.config import AppConfig, get_config
from qa_system.context_engineering import ContextEngineer, create_context_engineer
from qa_system.deduplication import Deduplicator, create_deduplicator
from qa_system.embedding_service import EmbeddingService, create_embedding_service
from qa_system.models import (
    ChatMessage,
    KnowledgeItem,
    KnowledgeSourceType,
    QARequest,
    ReferenceMapping,
    SSEEvent,
    SearchResults,
)
from qa_system.qa_prompt import QA_SYSTEM_PROMPT, QUERY_REWRITE_PROMPT, SIMPLE_EXTRACTION_PROMPT
from qa_system.neo4j_client import Neo4jClient, create_neo4j_client
from qa_system.ragflow_client import RAGFlowClient, create_ragflow_client


# ============================================================================
# Configuration for Query Processing
# ============================================================================

@dataclass
class QueryProcessorConfig:
    """查询处理器配置"""
    
    # Query rewrite settings
    max_history_turns: int = 5
    max_history_chars: int = 1000
    rewrite_max_tokens: int = 256
    rewrite_temperature: float = 0.3
    
    # Result filtering settings
    max_chunks_for_llm: int = 20
    max_chunk_text_length: int = 500
    max_total_chunks_text: int = 8000
    relevance_threshold: float = 0.5
    filter_max_tokens: int = 1024
    filter_temperature: float = 0.1
    
    # Feature flags
    enable_query_rewrite: bool = True
    enable_llm_filter: bool = True


class QAService:
    """
    问答服务
    
    协调 RAGFlow、Neo4j、Embedding、去重和 LLM 服务完成问答
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        config: AppConfig,
        ragflow_client: Optional[RAGFlowClient] = None,
        neo4j_client: Optional[Neo4jClient] = None,
        embedding_service: Optional[EmbeddingService] = None,
        deduplicator: Optional[Deduplicator] = None,
        context_engineer: Optional[ContextEngineer] = None,
        query_processor_config: Optional[QueryProcessorConfig] = None,
    ):
        """
        初始化问答服务
        
        Args:
            config: 应用配置
            ragflow_client: RAGFlow 客户端（可选）
            neo4j_client: Neo4j 客户端（可选）
            embedding_service: Embedding 服务（可选）
            deduplicator: 去重器（可选）
            context_engineer: 上下文工程师（可选）
            query_processor_config: 查询处理器配置（可选）
        """
        self.config = config
        self.query_processor_config = query_processor_config or QueryProcessorConfig()
        
        # 初始化子服务
        self.ragflow_client = ragflow_client or create_ragflow_client(config.ragflow)
        self.embedding_service = embedding_service or create_embedding_service(config.qwen)
        self.deduplicator = deduplicator or create_deduplicator(config.deduplication)
        self.context_engineer = context_engineer or create_context_engineer(config.qa)
        
        # Neo4j 客户端延迟初始化（需要连接）
        self._neo4j_client = neo4j_client
        
        # LLM 客户端
        self.llm_client = OpenAI(
            api_key=config.qwen.api_key,
            base_url=config.qwen.base_url,
        )
    
    @property
    def neo4j_client(self) -> Neo4jClient:
        """获取 Neo4j 客户端（延迟初始化）"""
        if self._neo4j_client is None:
            self._neo4j_client = create_neo4j_client(self.config.neo4j)
        return self._neo4j_client
    
    def close(self) -> None:
        """关闭所有连接"""
        if self._neo4j_client:
            self._neo4j_client.close()
            self._neo4j_client = None

    # ========================================================================
    # Query Rewriting
    # ========================================================================

    async def _rewrite_query_async(
        self,
        request: QARequest,
    ) -> str:
        """
        异步执行查询重写，消除代词、补充上下文。
        
        Args:
            request: QARequest 对象，包含 query 和 chat_history
            
        Returns:
            重写后的查询字符串
        """
        qp_config = self.query_processor_config
        
        # 如果禁用查询重写，直接返回原查询
        if not qp_config.enable_query_rewrite:
            return request.query
        
        # 如果没有历史对话且查询已经足够清晰，直接返回原查询
        if not request.chat_history and self._is_self_contained_query(request.query):
            logger.debug(f"Query is self-contained, skipping rewrite: {request.query}")
            return request.query
        
        # 构建历史对话文本
        chat_history_text = self._format_chat_history_for_rewrite(
            request.chat_history,
            max_turns=qp_config.max_history_turns,
            max_chars=qp_config.max_history_chars,
        )
        
        # 如果没有有效的历史对话，直接返回原查询
        if not chat_history_text.strip() or chat_history_text == "无历史对话":
            logger.debug(f"No valid chat history, returning original query: {request.query}")
            return request.query
        
        # 构建 prompt
        prompt = QUERY_REWRITE_PROMPT.format(
            chat_history=chat_history_text,
            query=request.query,
        )
        
        try:
            # 调用 LLM（放入线程池避免阻塞）
            response = await asyncio.to_thread(
                self._call_llm_sync,
                prompt=prompt,
                max_tokens=qp_config.rewrite_max_tokens,
                temperature=qp_config.rewrite_temperature,
                system_prompt="你是一个专业的查询重写助手，擅长将依赖上下文的查询改写为独立可理解的查询。",
            )
            
            # 清理响应
            rewritten_query = self._clean_rewritten_query(response, request.query)
            
            logger.info(f"Query rewritten: '{request.query}' -> '{rewritten_query}'")
            return rewritten_query
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Query rewrite failed: {e}, returning original query")
            return request.query

    def _is_self_contained_query(self, query: str) -> bool:
        """
        判断查询是否是独立可理解的（不依赖上下文）。
        
        Args:
            query: 用户查询
            
        Returns:
            True 如果查询是独立的，False 如果依赖上下文
        """
        # 常见的依赖上下文的代词和指示词
        context_dependent_patterns = [
            r'\b(它|这|那|这个|那个|这些|那些)\b',
            r'\b(他|她|他们|她们)\b',
            r'\b(上面|下面|前面|后面|刚才)\b',
            r'\b(继续|接着|然后呢|还有呢)\b',
            r'\b(为什么|怎么回事)\s*[？?]?\s*$',  # 单独的"为什么"通常需要上下文
            r'^(是的|对|好的|嗯)',  # 回应性开头
        ]
        
        for pattern in context_dependent_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, query):
                return False
        
        # 查询太短可能依赖上下文
        if len(query.strip()) < 5:
            return False
        
        return True

    def _format_chat_history_for_rewrite(
        self,
        chat_history: List[ChatMessage],
        max_turns: int = 5,
        max_chars: int = 1000,
    ) -> str:
        """
        格式化历史对话用于查询重写 prompt。
        
        Args:
            chat_history: ChatMessage 列表
            max_turns: 最大对话轮数
            max_chars: 最大字符数
            
        Returns:
            格式化后的历史对话文本
        """
        if not chat_history:
            return "无历史对话"
        
        # 取最近的对话
        recent_history = chat_history[-max_turns:]
        
        formatted_parts = []
        total_chars = 0
        
        for msg in recent_history:
            # 截断过长的回答
            answer = msg.answer
            if len(answer) > 200:
                answer = answer[:200] + "..."
            
            part = f"用户：{msg.query}\n助手：{answer}"
            
            if total_chars + len(part) > max_chars:
                break
            
            formatted_parts.append(part)
            total_chars += len(part)
        
        return "\n\n".join(formatted_parts) if formatted_parts else "无历史对话"

    def _clean_rewritten_query(self, response: str, original_query: str) -> str:
        """
        清理 LLM 返回的重写查询。
        
        Args:
            response: LLM 响应
            original_query: 原始查询（作为 fallback）
            
        Returns:
            清理后的查询
        """
        if not response:
            return original_query
        
        # 移除常见的前缀
        prefixes_to_remove = [
            "重写后的查询：",
            "重写后：",
            "查询：",
            "重写：",
        ]
        
        cleaned = response.strip()
        for prefix in prefixes_to_remove:
            if cleaned.startswith(prefix):
                cleaned = cleaned[len(prefix):].strip()
        
        # 移除引号
        if cleaned.startswith('"') and cleaned.endswith('"'):
            cleaned = cleaned[1:-1]
        if cleaned.startswith("'") and cleaned.endswith("'"):
            cleaned = cleaned[1:-1]
        
        # 如果结果为空或太短，返回原查询
        if not cleaned or len(cleaned) < 2:
            return original_query
        
        return cleaned

    async def _filter_results_by_llm_async(
        self,
        query: str,
        results: SearchResults,
    ) -> SearchResults:
        """
        使用 LLM 筛选检索结果，返回与查询相关的结果。
        
        Args:
            query: 用户查询（建议使用重写后的查询）
            results: SearchResults 对象
            
        Returns:
            筛选后的 SearchResults 对象
        """
        qp_config = self.query_processor_config
        
        # 如果禁用 LLM 筛选，直接返回原结果
        if not qp_config.enable_llm_filter:
            return results
        
        # 构建 chunk 文本和 ID 映射
        chunks_text, id_to_item, id_to_source = self._build_chunks_text(
            results=results,
            max_chunks=qp_config.max_chunks_for_llm,
            max_chunk_length=qp_config.max_chunk_text_length,
            max_total_length=qp_config.max_total_chunks_text,
        )
        
        # 如果没有检索结果，返回空结果
        if not chunks_text.strip():
            logger.warning("No chunks to filter, returning empty results")
            return SearchResults(
                ragflow_items=[],
                neo4j_vector_items=[],
                neo4j_adjacent_items=[],
                history_items=[],
            )
        
        # 构建 prompt
        prompt = SIMPLE_EXTRACTION_PROMPT.format(
            query=query,
            chunks_text=chunks_text,
        )
        
        try:
            # 调用 LLM（放入线程池避免阻塞）
            response = await asyncio.to_thread(
                self._call_llm_sync,
                prompt=prompt,
                max_tokens=qp_config.filter_max_tokens,
                temperature=qp_config.filter_temperature,
                system_prompt="你是一个精确的文档相关性评估专家，只输出JSON格式的评估结果。",
            )
            
            # 解析响应
            relevant_ids = self._parse_relevance_response(
                response=response,
                threshold=qp_config.relevance_threshold,
            )
            
            # 根据相关 ID 筛选结果
            filtered_results = self._filter_by_ids(
                results=results,
                relevant_ids=relevant_ids,
                id_to_source=id_to_source,
            )
            
            logger.info(
                f"Filtered results: ragflow={len(filtered_results.ragflow_items)}, "
                f"neo4j_vector={len(filtered_results.neo4j_vector_items)}, "
                f"neo4j_adjacent={len(filtered_results.neo4j_adjacent_items)}, "
                f"history={len(filtered_results.history_items)}"
            )
            
            return filtered_results
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Result filtering failed: {e}, returning original results")
            return results

    def _build_chunks_text(
        self,
        results: SearchResults,
        max_chunks: int = 20,
        max_chunk_length: int = 500,
        max_total_length: int = 8000,
    ) -> Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, str]]:
        """
        构建用于 LLM 评估的 chunks 文本。
        
        Args:
            results: SearchResults 对象
            max_chunks: 最大 chunk 数量
            max_chunk_length: 单个 chunk 最大长度
            max_total_length: 总文本最大长度
            
        Returns:
            Tuple of (chunks_text, id_to_item mapping, id_to_source mapping)
        """
        chunks_parts = []
        id_to_item: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        id_to_source: Dict[str, str] = {}  # chunk_id -> source_type
        total_length = 0
        chunk_count = 0
        
        # 按优先级处理各来源：neo4j_vector > ragflow > neo4j_adjacent > history
        source_items = [
            ("neo4j_vector", results.neo4j_vector_items),
            ("ragflow", results.ragflow_items),
            ("neo4j_adjacent", results.neo4j_adjacent_items),
            ("history", results.history_items),
        ]
        
        for source_type, items in source_items:
            for item in items:
                if chunk_count >= max_chunks:
                    break
                
                # 获取 item 的 id 和 text
                item_id = item.id
                item_text = item.text or ""
                item_name = getattr(item, 'name', '')
                
                # 截断过长的文本
                if len(item_text) > max_chunk_length:
                    item_text = item_text[:max_chunk_length] + "..."
                
                # 构建 chunk 文本
                chunk_text = f"[{item_id}] {item_name}：{item_text}"
                
                # 检查总长度
                if total_length + len(chunk_text) > max_total_length:
                    break
                
                chunks_parts.append(chunk_text)
                id_to_item[item_id] = item
                id_to_source[item_id] = source_type
                total_length += len(chunk_text)
                chunk_count += 1
            
            if chunk_count >= max_chunks or total_length >= max_total_length:
                break
        
        return "\n\n".join(chunks_parts), id_to_item, id_to_source

    def _parse_relevance_response(
        self,
        response: str,
        threshold: float = 0.5,
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """
        解析 LLM 返回的相关性评估结果。
        
        Args:
            response: LLM 响应（JSON 格式）
            threshold: 相关性阈值
            
        Returns:
            Dict mapping chunk_id to relevance score
        """
        if not response:
            return {}
        
        # 清理响应
        cleaned = response.strip()
        
        # 移除可能的 markdown 代码块标记
        if cleaned.startswith("```json"):
            cleaned = cleaned[7:]
        if cleaned.startswith("```"):
            cleaned = cleaned[3:]
        if cleaned.endswith("```"):
            cleaned = cleaned[:-3]
        cleaned = cleaned.strip()
        
        try:
            data = json.loads(cleaned)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            logger.warning(f"Failed to parse JSON response: {e}")
            # 尝试提取 JSON 对象
            match = re.search(r'\{[\s\S]*\}', response)
            if match:
                try:
                    data = json.loads(match.group())
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    logger.error("Failed to extract JSON from response")
                    return {}
            else:
                return {}
        
        relevant_ids: Dict[str, float] = {}
        
        # 解析 relevant_chunks
        relevant_chunks = data.get("relevant_chunks", [])
        for chunk in relevant_chunks:
            chunk_id = chunk.get("chunk_id", "")
            score = chunk.get("score", 0.0)
            
            # 确保 score 是数字
            try:
                score = float(score)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                score = 0.0
            
            if score >= threshold and chunk_id:
                relevant_ids[chunk_id] = score
        
        return relevant_ids

    def _filter_by_ids(
        self,
        results: SearchResults,
        relevant_ids: Dict[str, float],
        id_to_source: Dict[str, str],
    ) -> SearchResults:
        """
        根据相关 ID 筛选结果。
        
        Args:
            results: 原始 SearchResults
            relevant_ids: 相关 chunk ID 到分数的映射
            id_to_source: chunk ID 到来源类型的映射
            
        Returns:
            筛选后的 SearchResults
        """
        filtered_ragflow = []
        filtered_neo4j_vector = []
        filtered_neo4j_adjacent = []
        filtered_history = []
        
        # 筛选 ragflow_items
        for item in results.ragflow_items:
            if item.id in relevant_ids:
                filtered_ragflow.append(item)
        
        # 筛选 neo4j_vector_items
        for item in results.neo4j_vector_items:
            if item.id in relevant_ids:
                filtered_neo4j_vector.append(item)
        
        # 筛选 neo4j_adjacent_items
        for item in results.neo4j_adjacent_items:
            if item.id in relevant_ids:
                filtered_neo4j_adjacent.append(item)
        
        # 筛选 history_items
        for item in results.history_items:
            if item.id in relevant_ids:
                filtered_history.append(item)
        
        return SearchResults(
            ragflow_items=filtered_ragflow,
            neo4j_vector_items=filtered_neo4j_vector,
            neo4j_adjacent_items=filtered_neo4j_adjacent,
            history_items=filtered_history,
        )

    def _call_llm_sync(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        max_tokens: int = 512,
        temperature: float = 0.3,
        system_prompt: str = "",
    ) -> str:
        """
        同步调用 LLM。
        
        Args:
            prompt: 用户 prompt
            max_tokens: 最大 token 数
            temperature: 温度参数
            system_prompt: 系统 prompt
            
        Returns:
            LLM 响应文本
        """
        messages = []
        if system_prompt:
            messages.append({"role": "system", "content": system_prompt})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})
        
        response = self.llm_client.chat.completions.create(
            model=self.config.qwen.llm_model,
            messages=messages,
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            temperature=temperature,
            stream=False,
        )
        
        return response.choices[0].message.content or ""

    async def _search_ragflow_async(
        self,
        query: str,
        dataset_ids: List[str],
        use_threshold: bool = False,
    ) -> List[KnowledgeItem]:
        """
        异步执行 RAGFlow 检索
        
        通过 asyncio.to_thread 将同步 IO 操作转为异步，
        避免阻塞事件循环。
        
        Args:
            query: 查询问题
            dataset_ids: 知识库 ID 列表
            use_threshold: 是否使用相似度阈值模式
            
        Returns:
            KnowledgeItem 列表，失败时返回空列表
        """
        try:
            if use_threshold:
                logger.info("RAGFlow 检索: 使用相似度阈值模式")
                # 将同步调用放入线程池执行
                chunks = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self.ragflow_client.retrieve_threshold,
                    question=query,
                    similarity_threshold=self.config.qa.ragflow_similarity_threshold,
                    dataset_ids=dataset_ids,
                    use_reranker=True,
                )
                logger.info(f"RAGFlow 检索到 {len(chunks)} 个片段（阈值模式）")
            else:
                logger.info("RAGFlow 检索: 使用 Top K 模式")
                chunks = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self.ragflow_client.retrieve_top_k,
                    question=query,
                    top_k=self.config.qa.ragflow_top_n,
                    dataset_ids=dataset_ids,
                    use_reranker=True,
                )
                logger.info(f"RAGFlow 检索到 {len(chunks)} 个片段（Top K 模式）")
            
            # 转换为 KnowledgeItem（CPU 操作，无需 to_thread）
            items = [chunk.to_knowledge_item() for chunk in chunks]
            
            return items
            
        except Exception:
            exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback = sys.exc_info()
            error_message = repr(traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback))
            logger.error(f"RAGFlow 检索失败: {error_message}")
            return []

    async def _search_neo4j_async(
        self,
        query: str,
        use_threshold: bool = False,
        root_element_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> tuple[List[KnowledgeItem], List[KnowledgeItem]]:
        """
        异步执行 Neo4j 向量搜索和 N-hop 遍历
        
        包含三个 IO 操作：
        1. Embedding 生成
        2. 向量搜索
        3. N-hop 邻接节点遍历（多次调用）
        
        Args:
            query: 查询问题
            use_threshold: 是否使用相似度阈值模式
            root_element_id: 根节点 ID
            
        Returns:
            (向量搜索结果, 邻接节点结果) 元组，失败时返回空元组
        """
        if not query or not root_element_id:
            return [], []
        try:
            # Step 1: 生成查询 embedding
            query_embedding = await asyncio.to_thread(
                self.embedding_service.embed_query,
                query,
            )
            
            if not query_embedding or all(v == 0 for v in query_embedding):
                logger.warning("Embedding 生成失败，跳过 Neo4j 搜索")
                return [], []
            
            # Step 2: 向量搜索
            if not use_threshold:
                results = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self.neo4j_client.vector_search_top_k,
                    embedding=query_embedding,
                    top_k=self.config.qa.neo4j_top_k,
                    root_element_id=root_element_id,
                )
            else:
                results = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self.neo4j_client.vector_search_threshold,
                    embedding=query_embedding,
                    similarity_threshold=self.config.qa.neo4j_similarity_threshold,
                    root_element_id=root_element_id,
                )
            
            # 合并向量搜索结果（CPU 操作）
            seen_ids: set[str] = set()
            vector_items: List[KnowledgeItem] = []
            for node, score in results:
                if node.node_id not in seen_ids:
                    seen_ids.add(node.node_id)
                    vector_items.append(
                        node.to_knowledge_item(
                            source_type=KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_VECTOR,
                            similarity_score=score,
                        )
                    )
            
            # Step 3: N-hop 遍历 - 并行获取所有邻接节点
            async def fetch_adjacent(item: KnowledgeItem) -> List[KnowledgeItem]:
                """获取单个节点的邻接节点"""
                if not item.element_id:
                    return []
                
                adjacent_nodes = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self.neo4j_client.get_adjacent_nodes,
                    node_id=item.element_id,
                    max_depth=self.config.qa.n_hop,
                )
                return adjacent_nodes
            
            # 并行获取所有 vector_items 的邻接节点
            adjacent_results = await asyncio.gather(
                *[fetch_adjacent(item) for item in vector_items],
                return_exceptions=True,  # 单个失败不影响整体
            )
            
            # 合并邻接节点结果
            adjacent_items: List[KnowledgeItem] = []
            for result in adjacent_results:
                if isinstance(result, Exception):
                    logger.warning(f"获取邻接节点失败: {result}")
                    continue
                
                for adj_node in result:
                    if adj_node.node_id not in seen_ids:
                        seen_ids.add(adj_node.node_id)
                        adjacent_items.append(
                            adj_node.to_knowledge_item(
                                source_type=KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_ADJACENT,
                                similarity_score=0.0,
                            )
                        )
            
            logger.info(f"Neo4j 搜索完成: 向量结果={len(vector_items)}, 邻接结果={len(adjacent_items)}")
            return vector_items, adjacent_items
            
        except Exception:
            exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback = sys.exc_info()
            error_message = repr(traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback))
            logger.error(f"Neo4j 搜索失败: {error_message}")
            return [], []

    def _convert_chat_history(
        self,
        chat_history: List[ChatMessage],
    ) -> List[KnowledgeItem]:
        """
        将历史对话转换为知识项
        
        Args:
            chat_history: 历史对话列表
            
        Returns:
            KnowledgeItem 列表
        """
        items = []
        for i, msg in enumerate(chat_history):
            items.append(
                KnowledgeItem(
                    id=f"history_{i}",
                    name=f"历史对话 {i+1}",
                    text=msg.to_context_string(),
                    source_type=KnowledgeSourceType.CHAT_HISTORY,
                    similarity_score=0.0,
                )
            )
        return items

    async def _search_all_sources(
        self,
        request: QARequest,
        rewritten_query: str,
    ) -> SearchResults:
        """
        并行执行所有搜索源，带异常隔离和超时控制。
        
        设计考量：
        - 使用 return_exceptions=True 避免单点失败导致全部失败
        - 每个任务独立超时，防止慢查询拖垮整体
        - 失败时返回空列表，保证后续步骤输入稳定
        
        Args:
            request: 原始请求
            rewritten_query: 重写后的查询（用于检索）
        """
        
        async def safe_ragflow_search() -> list:
            """RAGFlow 搜索，带独立异常处理"""
            try:
                return await asyncio.wait_for(
                    self._search_ragflow_async(
                        query=rewritten_query,  # 使用重写后的查询
                        dataset_ids=request.dataset_ids,
                    ),
                    timeout=10.0,
                )
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                logger.warning("RAGFlow 搜索超时，返回空结果")
                return []
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"RAGFlow 搜索失败: {e}")
                return []
        
        async def safe_neo4j_search() -> tuple[list, list]:
            """Neo4j 搜索，带独立异常处理"""
            try:
                return await asyncio.wait_for(
                    self._search_neo4j_async(
                        query=rewritten_query,  # 使用重写后的查询
                        root_element_id=request.element_id,
                    ),
                    timeout=15.0,
                )
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                logger.warning("Neo4j 搜索超时，返回空结果")
                return [], []
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Neo4j 搜索失败: {e}")
                return [], []
        
        async def safe_convert_history() -> list:
            """历史转换，CPU 操作但为保持一致性也包装"""
            try:
                return self._convert_chat_history(request.chat_history)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"历史转换失败: {e}")
                return []
        
        # 并行执行，任何一个失败不影响其他
        ragflow_result, neo4j_result, history_result = await asyncio.gather(
            safe_ragflow_search(),
            safe_neo4j_search(),
            safe_convert_history(),
        )
        
        neo4j_vector_items, neo4j_adjacent_items = neo4j_result
        
        return SearchResults(
            ragflow_items=ragflow_result,
            neo4j_vector_items=neo4j_vector_items,
            neo4j_adjacent_items=neo4j_adjacent_items,
            history_items=history_result,
        )

    def process_request(
        self,
        request: QARequest,
    ) -> Generator[SSEEvent, None, None]:
        """
        处理问答请求（同步生成器）
        
        完整流程：
        1. 查询重写（消除代词、补充上下文）
        2. 并行检索（RAGFlow + Neo4j）
        3. LLM 结果筛选
        4. MinHash 去重
        5. 上下文工程
        6. LLM 流式生成
        
        Args:
            request: 问答请求
            
        Yields:
            SSEEvent 对象
        """
        try:
            logger.info(f"开始处理问答请求: query='{request.query[:50]}...'")
            
            # 使用 asyncio.run 执行异步流程
            rewritten_query, filtered_results = asyncio.run(
                self._async_search_and_filter(request)
            )
            
            logger.info(f"查询重写结果: '{rewritten_query}'")
            logger.info(
                f"筛选后结果: ragflow={len(filtered_results.ragflow_items)}, "
                f"neo4j_vector={len(filtered_results.neo4j_vector_items)}, "
                f"neo4j_adjacent={len(filtered_results.neo4j_adjacent_items)}"
            )

            # Step 4: MinHash 去重（按优先级）
            all_items = self.deduplicator.deduplicate_by_source(
                neo4j_vector_items=filtered_results.neo4j_vector_items,
                ragflow_items=filtered_results.ragflow_items,
                neo4j_adjacent_items=filtered_results.neo4j_adjacent_items,
                chat_history_items=filtered_results.history_items,
            )
            
            # Step 5: 上下文工程
            context, reference_mapping = self.context_engineer.build_context(
                query=rewritten_query,  # 使用重写后的查询
                knowledge_items=all_items,
                chat_history=request.chat_history,
            )
            
            # Step 6: 构建 prompt
            prompt = self.context_engineer.build_prompt(
                query=rewritten_query,  # 使用重写后的查询
                context=context,
                reference_mapping=reference_mapping,
            )
            
            # Step 7: LLM 流式生成
            yield from self._stream_llm_response(
                prompt, 
                reference_mapping, 
                course_name=request.course_name
            )
            
        except Exception:
            exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback = sys.exc_info()
            error_message = repr(traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback))
            logger.error(f"问答处理失败: {error_message}")
            yield SSEEvent.create_done()

    async def _async_search_and_filter(
        self,
        request: QARequest,
    ) -> Tuple[str, SearchResults]:
        """
        异步执行搜索和筛选流程。
        
        流程：
        1. 查询重写
        2. 并行检索
        3. LLM 筛选
        
        Args:
            request: QARequest 对象
            
        Returns:
            Tuple of (rewritten_query, filtered_results)
        """
        # Step 1: 查询重写
        rewritten_query = await self._rewrite_query_async(request)
        
        # Step 2: 并行检索（使用重写后的查询）
        results = await self._search_all_sources(request, rewritten_query)
        
        # Step 3: LLM 筛选（使用重写后的查询）
        filtered_results = await self._filter_results_by_llm_async(
            query=rewritten_query,
            results=results,
        )
        
        return rewritten_query, filtered_results

    def _stream_llm_response(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        reference_mapping: ReferenceMapping,
        course_name: str = ""
    ) -> Generator[SSEEvent, None, None]:
        """
        流式生成 LLM 响应
        
        Args:
            prompt: 完整提示词
            reference_mapping: 引用映射
            course_name: 课程名称
            
        Yields:
            SSEEvent 对象
        """
        try:
            # 存储文档名和块信息的映射
            doc_info_map = defaultdict(lambda: {"name": None, "chunks": []})

            for elem in reference_mapping.nodes:
                if elem.source_type == KnowledgeSourceType.RAGFLOW.value:
                    chunk_info = {
                        "chunk_id": elem.element_id,
                        "chunk_content": elem.text,
                        "positions": elem.metadata.get("positions", [])
                    }
                    # 如果还没有记录文档名，则设置
                    if doc_info_map[elem.doc_id]["name"] is None:
                        doc_info_map[elem.doc_id]["name"] = elem.name
                    doc_info_map[elem.doc_id]["chunks"].append(chunk_info)

            # 构建最终结果
            chunk_infos = {
                "type": "references",
                "content": [
                    {
                        "document_name": info["name"],
                        "document_id": doc_id,
                        "chunk_list": info["chunks"]
                    }
                    for doc_id, info in doc_info_map.items()
                ]
            }
            yield SSEEvent.create_reference(json.dumps(chunk_infos, ensure_ascii=False))

            # 课程名称仅作为上下文参考，不作为限制条件
            course_context = f"当前课程：{course_name}\n" if course_name else ""

            # 调用 LLM
            response = self.llm_client.chat.completions.create(
                model=self.config.qwen.llm_model,
                messages=[
                    {"role": "system", "content": QA_SYSTEM_PROMPT.format(course_context=course_context)},
                    {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
                ],
                max_tokens=self.config.qwen.max_tokens,
                temperature=self.config.qwen.temperature,
                stream=True,
            )

            # 流式输出回答
            for chunk in response:
                if chunk.choices and chunk.choices[0].delta.content:
                    content = chunk.choices[0].delta.content
                    content = json.dumps({
                        "type": "normal",
                        "content": content,
                    }, ensure_ascii=False)
                    yield SSEEvent.create_data(content)
            
            knowledge_points = {
                "type": "knowledge_points",
                "content": [
                    {
                        "element_id": node.element_id,
                        "name": node.name,
                    }
                    for node in reference_mapping.nodes
                    if node.source_type == KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_VECTOR.value 
                    or node.source_type == KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_ADJACENT.value
                ]
            }
            yield SSEEvent.create_knowledge_point(json.dumps(knowledge_points, ensure_ascii=False))

            # 提取问题
            question_infos = {
                "type": "questions",
                "content": []
            }
            question_contents = []
            for node in reference_mapping.nodes:
                if node.source_type in (KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_VECTOR.value, KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_ADJACENT.value):
                    node_properties = node.metadata.get("properties")
                    if node_properties:
                        for question in node_properties.get("node_questions", []):
                            if isinstance(question, dict) and question.get("question"):
                                question_contents.append(question.get("question"))
            question_infos["content"] = question_contents
            yield SSEEvent.create_question(json.dumps(question_infos, ensure_ascii=False))

            # 提取文档
            doc_infos = {
                "type": "documents",
                "content": []
            }
            doc_contents = []
            for node in reference_mapping.nodes:
                if node.source_type in (KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_VECTOR.value, KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_ADJACENT.value):
                    node_properties = node.metadata.get("properties")
                    if node_properties:
                        for node_document in node_properties.get("node_documents", []):
                            if isinstance(node_document, dict) and node_document.get("document_name") and node_document.get("document_url"):
                                doc_contents.append(node_document)
            doc_infos["content"] = doc_contents
            yield SSEEvent.create_doc(json.dumps(doc_infos, ensure_ascii=False))

            # 提取视频
            video_infos = {
                "type": "videos",
                "content": []
            }
            video_contents = []
            for node in reference_mapping.nodes:
                if node.source_type in (KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_VECTOR.value, KnowledgeSourceType.NEO4J_ADJACENT.value):
                    node_properties = node.metadata.get("properties")
                    if node_properties:
                        for node_video in node_properties.get("node_videos", []):
                            if isinstance(node_video, dict) and node_video.get("video_name") and node_video.get("video_url"):
                                video_contents.append(node_video)
            video_infos["content"] = video_contents
            yield SSEEvent.create_video(json.dumps(video_infos, ensure_ascii=False))
            
            # 输出结束标记
            yield SSEEvent.create_done()
            
        except Exception:
            exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback = sys.exc_info()
            error_message = repr(traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback))
            logger.error(f"LLM 流式生成失败: {error_message}")
            yield SSEEvent.create_done()

    def _yield_referenced_nodes(
        self,
        full_text: str,
        reference_mapping: ReferenceMapping,
    ) -> Generator[dict, None, None]:
        """
        生成被引用的知识点字典
        
        Args:
            full_text: LLM 完整回答文本
            reference_mapping: 引用映射
            
        Yields:
            知识点字典
        """
        referenced_node_ids = re.findall(r'\[node\d+\]', full_text)

        # 去重并保持原始顺序
        seen = set()
        unique_referenced_node_ids = []
        for node_id in referenced_node_ids:
            if node_id not in seen:
                seen.add(node_id)
                unique_referenced_node_ids.append(node_id)

        # 输出知识点引用
        for node in reference_mapping.nodes:
            if f"[{node.node_id}]" in unique_referenced_node_ids:
                logger.info(f"引用知识点: {node.node_id} - {node.name}")
                yield SSEEvent.create_knowledge_point(node.to_json())


def create_qa_service(
    config: Optional[AppConfig] = None,
    query_processor_config: Optional[QueryProcessorConfig] = None,
) -> QAService:
    """
    工厂函数：创建问答服务
    
    Args:
        config: 应用配置
        query_processor_config: 查询处理器配置
        
    Returns:
        QAService 实例
    """
    config = config or get_config()
    return QAService(config, query_processor_config=query_processor_config)


def process_qa_request(request: QARequest) -> Generator[SSEEvent, None, None]:
    """
    便捷函数：处理问答请求
    
    Args:
        request: 问答请求
        
    Yields:
        SSEEvent 对象
    """
    service = create_qa_service()
    try:
        yield from service.process_request(request)
    finally:
        service.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":

        print(event.to_sse_string(), end="", flush=True)
